headline: Certified Police Records Technician eligibility list #26-19 and approved filling Library Technical Assistant and Fire Marshal positions; tabled Part-time Librarian list.
summary: Commissioners approved 9 Part Time Librarian 1 applications and certified the Police Records Technician list. They also voted to fill the Library Technical Assistant and Fire Marshal positions. They tabled the Part-time Librarian list and a request to amend the Library Manager applications list, which moves to the next regular meeting on 10.6.2026.
decisions: Approved the 9.15.2026 regular meeting minutes, unanimously.
Approved 9 qualifying Part Time Librarian 1 applications and found one applicant not qualified, unanimously.
Approved certifying Police Records Technician list #26-19, unanimously.
Tabled certification of the Part-time Librarian list.
Approved filling the Library Technical Assistant position, unanimously.
Approved filling the Fire Marshal position, unanimously.
Tabled the request to amend the Library Manager applications list from 13 to 14, to the next regular meeting on 10.6.2026.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Civil Service Commission Minutes         
         
Special Meeting 
 
3:00 PM, September 25, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 3:43 P.M. 
2. ATTENDANCE   
 Commissioners in attendance: Curt Andrews, Helen Ward. 
Staff in attendance: J. Susy Diaz-Callands, Lee Palmer, 
Michael White. 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 
 
  1. Review and approval of the CSC regular Meeting Minutes from 9.15.2026  
  Commissioner Andrews motioned to approve the 9.15.2026 regular meeting minutes. 
Commissioner Ward Seconded the motion. 
Motion Passes unanimously.  
4. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 None. 
5. CORRESPONDENCE   
 None. 
6. ACTION ITEMS   
 
 
 1. Review and approval of the following job applications: 
• Part Time Librarian 1 
 
       
  Commissioner Ward motioned to accept 9 qualifying applications, and deemed one 
applicant not qualified.  
Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion. 
Motion passes unanimously.  
 2. New eligibility list: 
• Police Records Technician 
• Part-time Librarian
Commissioner Andrews motioned to certify list #26-19 Police Records Technician. 
Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
          Motion passes unanimously. 
  
Commissioner Andrews motioned to table the certification of Part-time Librarian list.  
Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
Motions is tabled  
 3. RTF: 
• Library Technical Assistant 
• Fire Marshal 
 
       
  Commissioner Andrews motioned to fill the Library Technical Assistant position. 
 
Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
Commissioner Andrews motioned to fill the Fire Marshal position. 
 
Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
Motions passed unanimously. 
 
 4. Amendment to September 15, 2026, approval of the Library Manager applications list 
from 13 to 14 adding one(1) additional eligible candidate. 
       
  Commissioner Andrews motioned to table the request to amend the accepted Library 
Managers applications. 
Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
Motion is tabled to the next Regular Civil Service Meeting on 10.6.2026.  
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 None. 
8. REPORTS   
 None. 
9. OLD BUSINESS   
 None. 
10. NEW BUSINESS   
 none. 
11. ADJOURNMENT   
 Commissioner Andrews motioned to adjourn. 
Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
Motion passed unanimously, meeting adjourned at 3:52 p.m..
